title: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents must decide when another search is worth its cost. Answer-success probabilities capture question difficulty, while this decision requires estimating the additional benefit of search. We introduce SearchHorizonBench, a benchmark for learning and evaluating search value from execution experience. Paired continuations and repeated executions separate expected search gain from generation noise and connect prediction quality to decision utility. The resource contains 45,632 executions across 3,168 questions. On 1,632 held-out questions, historical calibration reduces Brier error by 16.2%, with the improvement concentrated in success-level information. Search gains have a standard deviation of 21.4 percentage points, and tested historical estimators explain less than 2% of this variance in point estimates. Matched-configuration learning curves probe this distinction across training scales. At the reference token price, free selection

translated_title: SearchHorizonBench：一个用于评估AI智能体搜索价值的基准
translated_abstract: AI智能体必须决定何时再进行一次搜索是值得其成本的。答案成功概率可以捕捉问题的难度，而这一决策则需要估计搜索所带来的额外收益。我们提出了SearchHorizonBench，这是一个用于从执行经验中学习和评估搜索价值的基准。通过配对的延续和重复执行，该基准将预期搜索增益与生成噪声分离开来，并将预测质量与决策效用联系起来。该资源包含跨3,168个问题的45,632次执行。在1,632个留出问题上，历史校准将Brier误差降低了16.2%，且改进主要集中在成功层面的信息上。搜索增益的标准差为21.4个百分点，而所测试的历史估计器在点估计中仅能解释该方差的不到2%。匹配配置的学习曲线在多个训练规模上探究了这一区别。在参考token价格下，自由选择（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SearchHorizonBench基准，通过配对延续和重复执行从执行经验中学习评估AI智能体搜索的价值，发现历史校准可将Brier误差降低16.2%，但现有历史估计器几乎无法预测搜索增益的巨大方差。
